title: Syntax scan state identity
statement: For every finite Boolean list $x$ and every state $q \in \{0,1,2,3,4,5\}$, scanning $x$ from the combined syntax state corresponding to $q$ ends at the combined syntax state corresponding to the result of scanning $x$ from $q$ using the six-state syntax transition.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a finite list of Boolean values
$q$ is one of the six syntax states
